label: Orbit arithmetic I
title: Long cycles separate into shape recurrence and spatial drift
summary: At ring size 14, Rule 110's period 91 becomes a 13-step shape recurrence with seven positional repetitions; Rule 54's period 112 becomes 16 times seven. Six cycles form three translation families.
takeaway: Remove spatial drift before interpreting arithmetic in temporal periods; the residual shape periods still depend on ring size.
